Description: Cold-fermented 24 hours for a blistered thin crust. One batch yields about four 280 g bases.
Method: Bloom the yeast with the sugar in warm water | Add the flour and salt then knead 10 min | Work in the olive oil until smooth and elastic | Cover and cold-ferment 24 hr | Divide into 280 g balls and rest 1 hr at room temperature

Description: Tomato base finished with torn basil off the heat. Keeps three days chilled.
Method: Blanch peel and core the tomatoes | Sweat the onion and garlic in olive oil without colour | Add the tomato and simmer 30 min | Season with salt sugar and oregano | Blend coarse then fold in the torn basil

Description: Parmesan cream sauce made fresh each service. Split-prone — hold below 70°C.
Method: Melt the butter and sweat the garlic without colour | Add the cream and milk then reduce by a quarter | Whisk in the grated parmesan off the heat | Season with salt and black pepper | Pass through a fine sieve

Description: Compound butter for garlic bread and finishing. Rolls and freezes well.
Method: Soften the butter to room temperature | Grate the garlic to a paste | Beat in the garlic parsley and salt | Roll in parchment and chill until firm

Description: House burger sauce mixed cold in one bowl. Keeps five days chilled.
Method: Whisk the mayonnaise ketchup and mustard together | Grate in the garlic | Season with black pepper | Rest 1 hr before service

Description: Hand-formed chicken patties. One batch yields about eight 130 g patties.
Method: Mince the chicken breast coarse | Sweat the onion and garlic then cool completely | Mix with the breadcrumbs egg and seasoning | Form 130 g patties and rest chilled 1 hr | Seal in sunflower oil before service
